description: List what a service board allows — statuses, types, sub-types, items and teams. These are the exact names cw_create_ticket and cw_update_ticket take, and they are BOARD-SCOPED: the same name means a different id on another board. Get the board id from cw_list_boards.

response_format.description: Output format: human-readable markdown (default) or structured JSON
